A03,2026-01,1500,900

C03,2026-03,700,770
D01,2026-04,2600,1690
D02,2026-04,1700,1020
D03,2026-04,900,630
D04,2026-04,500,
"""

print("=" * 60)
print("【模拟数据】订单明细清洗（不代表任何公司真实经营情况）")
print("=" * 60)

df["cost"] = df["cost"].astype(float)
df["gross_profit"] = df["revenue"] - df["cost"]

neg = df[df["gross_profit"] < 0]

# ---------- 5. 清洗结果概览 ----------
clean_rows = len(df)
print(f"清洗后记录数: {clean_rows}  (原始 {raw_rows} - 重复 {dup_count} - 缺失 {miss_count})")
print(f"清洗后总收入: {df['revenue'].sum():.2f} 元")
print(f"清洗后总成本: {df['cost'].sum():.2f} 元")
print(f"清洗后总毛利: {df['gross_profit'].sum():.2f} 元")
print(f"涉及月份: {sorted(df['month'].unique().tolist())}")

df = df[["order_id", "month", "revenue", "cost", "gross_profit"]]
df.to_csv("clean.csv", index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
print("已写出 clean.csv")
print("=" * 60)

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.rcParams['font.sans-serif'] = ['Microsoft YaHei', 'SimHei', 'DejaVu Sans']
plt.rcParams['axes.unicode_minus'] = False

import os
import pandas as pd

# ============================================================
# 本步骤职责：读取 clean.csv，按 month 汇总，写 monthly_summary.csv
# 输入契约：clean.csv（前序产物，必须存在，禁止重造数据）
# 输出契约：monthly_summary.csv
# 列名严格为：month,revenue,cost,gross_profit,gross_margin,orders
# 注意：本步骤不生成 figure.svg / report.md（那是下一步职责）
# ============================================================

INPUT_FILE = "clean.csv"
OUTPUT_FILE = "monthly_summary.csv"

# ---------- 1. 校验输入文件存在（缺失必须报错，禁止重造） ----------
if not os.path.exists(INPUT_FILE):
    raise FileNotFoundError(
        f"缺少约定输入文件 {INPUT_FILE}，本步骤禁止重新生成原始数据。"
    )

# ---------- 2. 只读取 clean.csv，不复制原始数据重算 ----------
clean = pd.read_csv(INPUT_FILE)

required_cols = {"order_id", "month", "revenue", "cost"}
missing_cols = required_cols - set(clean.columns)
if missing_cols:
    raise ValueError(f"clean.csv 缺少必要列: {missing_cols}")

print("=" * 60)
print("【模拟数据声明】本步骤基于公开模拟订单数据，非真实公司经营数据。")
print("=" * 60)
print(f"读取 clean.csv 行数: {len(clean)}")
print(f"clean.csv 列: {list(clean.columns)}")

# ---------- 3. 规避陷阱：确认 clean.csv 已去重、无缺失（血缘校验） ----------
# 陷阱规避：不重复计数 —— 检查 order_id 是否唯一
dup_in_clean = int(clean["order_id"].duplicated().sum())
print(f"[血缘校验] clean.csv 中重复 order_id 数: {dup_in_clean}（应为 0）")

# 陷阱规避：收入缺失不得用 0 冒充 —— 检查 revenue/cost 缺失
na_rev = int(clean["revenue"].isna().sum())
na_cost = int(clean["cost"].isna().sum())
print(f"[血缘校验] clean.csv 中 revenue 缺失数: {na_rev}（应为 0）")
print(f"[血缘校验] clean.csv 中 cost 缺失数: {na_cost}（应为 0）")

if dup_in_clean != 0 or na_rev != 0 or na_cost != 0:
    raise ValueError(
        "clean.csv 未满足清洗契约（应已去重且无缺失），拒绝继续汇总。"
    )

# ---------- 4. 按 month 汇总收入、成本、订单数 ----------
# 陷阱规避：毛利率必须用 总毛利/总收入，不能平均单笔毛利率
monthly = (
    clean.groupby("month", as_index=False)
    .agg(
        revenue=("revenue", "sum"),
        cost=("cost", "sum"),
        orders=("order_id", "count"),
    )
    .sort_values("month")
    .reset_index(drop=True)
)

# 毛利 = 总收入 - 总成本
monthly["gross_profit"] = monthly["revenue"] - monthly["cost"]
# 毛利率 = 总毛利 / 总收入（加权口径，非平均单笔毛利率）
monthly["gross_margin"] = monthly["gross_profit"] / monthly["revenue"]

# 列名严格排序
monthly = monthly[["month", "revenue", "cost", "gross_profit", "gross_margin", "orders"]]

print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("【月度汇总结果】（金额单位：元）")
print("=" * 60)
print(monthly.to_string(index=False))

# ---------- 5. 核对：按月汇总之和 == 清洗明细合计（绝对容差 1e-8） ----------
TOL = 1e-8
sum_rev_detail = float(clean["revenue"].sum())
sum_cost_detail = float(clean["cost"].sum())
sum_rev_monthly = float(monthly["revenue"].sum())
sum_cost_monthly = float(monthly["cost"].sum())
sum_orders_detail = int(len(clean))
sum_orders_monthly = int(monthly["orders"].sum())

print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("【一致性核对】绝对容差 = 1e-8")
print("=" * 60)
print(f"收入  明细合计={sum_rev_detail:.6f}  月度合计={sum_rev_monthly:.6f}  "
      f"差={abs(sum_rev_detail - sum_rev_monthly):.2e}")
print(f"成本  明细合计={sum_cost_detail:.6f}  月度合计={sum_cost_monthly:.6f}  "
      f"差={abs(sum_cost_detail - sum_cost_monthly):.2e}")
print(f"订单数 明细={sum_orders_detail}  月度={sum_orders_monthly}")

assert abs(sum_rev_detail - sum_rev_monthly) < TOL, "收入汇总不一致"
assert abs(sum_cost_detail - sum_cost_monthly) < TOL, "成本汇总不一致"
assert sum_orders_detail == sum_orders_monthly, "订单数汇总不一致"

# 毛利率口径核对：总毛利 / 总收入
total_gp = sum_rev_monthly - sum_cost_monthly
total_gm = total_gp / sum_rev_monthly
print(f"\n整体毛利率（总毛利/总收入）= {total_gm:.6f} "
      f"（总毛利={total_gp:.2f} 元，总收入={sum_rev_monthly:.2f} 元）")
print("[核对通过] 按月汇总之和等于清洗明细合计；毛利率为总毛利除以总收入。")

# ---------- 6. 落盘 ----------
monthly.to_csv(OUTPUT_FILE, index=False, encoding="utf-8-sig")
print(f"\n已写出: {OUTPUT_FILE}（{len(monthly)} 行）")
